PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/ontology/refinements#>
SELECT ?name ?tsid ?point WHERE {
  ?point brick:hasName ?name .
  FILTER(?name IN ("AHU01","AHU03","SupplyFan_AHU02"))
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?ref .
  ?ref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
}
